command.extract.hard-strings-batch: Extract Chinese hard-coded strings in this file
config.annotation_delimiter: Separator between the key and its inline translation, e.g. "→" or "|".
config.annotation_in_place: Show annotation in place instead of appending to the tail
config.annotation_max_length: Max number of characters shown in the inline annotations. Excess characters will display as an ellipses (...)
config.annotations: Show each key's translation as grey inline text right next to it.
config.auto_detection: Enable locales auto detection for projects
config.baidu_app_secret: Secret paired with the APP ID, used to sign each request.
config.baidu_appid: APP ID of your Baidu Translate app (console → developer info).
config.deepl_api_key: API key to use DeepL translate engine
config.deepl_use_free_api_entry: Use DeepL Free API entry point
config.default_namespace: Namespace used for keys that carry none, when the project splits locale files by namespace.
config.derived_keys: Rules marking derived keys in the usage report, written with a {key} placeholder, e.g. "{key}_plural". When the base key is in use, its derived keys are not reported as unused.
config.dir_structure: Preferred directory structure to organize locale files
config.dir_structure.auto: Detect from the existing structure of the locale folder
config.dir_structure.dir: Put files that share a namespace into a sub-directory named after it
config.dir_structure.file: Keep every locale file directly in the locale folder, no sub-directories
config.disable_path_parsing: Do not treat dots in key paths as nesting — "a.b" stays the literal key "a.b".
config.disabled: Disable i18n CN for the project
config.display_language: Locale shown in inline annotations, the sidebar and the missing-translation counts.
config.editor_prefer_editor: Open the sidebar key editor instead of the inline input box when editing a translation.
config.enabled_frameworks: Frameworks to support. Empty means: detect them from manifest files and packages. A framework decides which syntax is recognised as a key usage, and how keys map to files.
config.enabled_frameworks.custom: Custom — pair it with regex.usageMatch and friends to fit any syntax
config.enabled_frameworks.general: Generic fallback when there is no framework-specific syntax
config.enabled_frameworks.vscode: VS Code extension l10n / localize calls
config.enabled_frameworks.vue-sfc: Locale messages live inside .vue files as <i18n> blocks
config.enabled_parsers: Locale file formats to handle. Empty means: use the formats of the detected frameworks. It only decides which files are treated as locale files — add e.g. yaml when the project uses .yml.
config.enabled_parsers.js: Scan keys in .js / .mjs — read-only, never writes a locale file.
config.enabled_parsers.ts: Scan keys in .ts — read-only, never writes a locale file.
config.encoding: Encoding used to read and write locale files. Any Node.js encoding name works, e.g. utf-8, utf-16le, gbk.
config.extract_auto_detect: Enables hard-coded strings detection automatically whenever opening a supported file
config.extract_auto_import_statement: Import statement inserted when extracted code uses $t but the script file has no import for it. Empty disables it. Only applies to ts/js/tsx/jsx.
config.extract_ignored: Exact strings to skip during hard-coded text detection, e.g. "OK", "Cancel". Use ignoredRegex for patterns.
config.extract_ignored_by_files: Per-file ignore list, shaped as { "src/foo.vue": ["string to ignore"] }. Paths are relative to the workspace root.
config.extract_ignored_regex: Regular expressions — any hard-coded text matching one of them is skipped.
config.extract_parsers_babel: Parser options for extracting JS/TS/JSX/TSX, see https://github.com/jianghongXk/i18n-ally/blob/main/src/extraction/parsers/options.ts
config.extract_parsers_html: Parser options for extracting HTML, see https://github.com/jianghongXk/i18n-ally/blob/main/src/extraction/parsers/options.ts
config.extract_require_cjk: Only extract strings containing CJK characters. Turn off if you also need English UI strings extracted.
config.fallback_from_other_locales: When the source locale has no value for a key (empty or missing), allow taking the value found in another locale as the source text, filling the source locale and the remaining empty ones. Typical case: `chs.json` lacks a key while `can.json` / `en.json` already have it. Turn it off to skip such keys instead of creating translation jobs.
config.fallback_source_order: Preferred source locales when cross-referencing, e.g. `["can", "en"]` means take can's text first. Empty means: walk the project's locale list and use the first locale that has a value. Locales not listed here still act as a fallback, and a target locale is never used as its own source.
config.full_reload_on_changed: Perform a full reload on locale file changes. (for .js/.ts dynamic import)
config.ignore_files: Locale files to ignore on loading. Accepting an array of glob.
config.ignored_locales: Locale codes excluded from display and translation, written the way they appear in file names (e.g. can). They get no annotations, no sidebar entry and no batch translation.
config.include_subfolders: Also scan sub-directories of the locale paths when looking for locale files.
config.indent: Number of spaces per indent level when writing JSON / YAML locale files.
config.keep_fulfill: When writing a key, also create it as an empty string in every other locale, so all locale files keep the same key set.
config.key_max_length: If specified, the generated key on extracting will be truncated to this number of characters (excluding the keyPrefix). Defaults to unlimited.
config.key_prefix: String prepended to the extracted keypath. Supports {fileName} (file name with extension) and {fileNameWithoutExt}. Ignored when the strategy is "empty" or "source".
config.keygen_strategy: How the keypath is generated when extracting hard-coded strings
config.keygen_strategy.empty: Do not generate a keypath — leave it empty and type it yourself (keyPrefix is ignored)
config.keygen_strategy.random: Use a random string, e.g. V1StGXR8Z5jdHi6BmyT
config.keygen_strategy.slug: Slugify the text into a readable key — "Submit button" → submit-button; non-Latin text is transliterated, Chinese → pinyin (「提交按钮」→ ti-jiao-an-niu)
config.keygen_strategy.source: Use the source text itself as the key, e.g. "提交" → 提交 (keyPrefix is ignored; handy for source-as-key setups)
config.keygen_style: Case style applied to the generated keypath (delimiter and letter case)
config.keygen_style.default: Keep what the strategy produced — slug joins words with i18n-ally.preferredDelimiter, default "-"
config.keys_in_use: Keys to mark as in use despite not appearing in the code
config.keystyle: How keys are written into the locale files
config.keystyle.auto: Detect from the structure of the existing locale files
config.language_tag_system: How locale codes in file names are normalized
config.language_tag_system.bcp47: Standard BCP 47 tags, e.g. zh-CN, en-US
config.language_tag_system.legacy: Legacy two-letter primary codes only, e.g. zh, en — codes like chs / can are dropped
config.language_tag_system.none: No normalization — the file name is used as the locale as-is
config.locale_country_map: Map a two-letter locale code to a country code for the flag icon, e.g. { "en": "US", "zh": "CN" }.
config.locale_files: **Explicitly declare which files are locale files**, as paths relative to the workspace root, e.g. `src/assets/chs.json`. Leave it empty to detect them via `#i18n-ally.pathMatcher#`; once set, **only the listed files are loaded**, so plain data files such as `commWord.json` or `iconfont.json` in the same folder are no longer mistaken for locales. The recommended way is [Select locale files one by one](command:i18n-ally.select-locale-files), which writes the choice into this project's `.vscode/settings.json`.
config.locale_map:
Map the identifiers used by your locale files to the language codes translation engines expect. Flat form `{"chs": "zh", "can": "cht"}` applies to every engine; per-engine form `{"baidu": {"chs": "zh"}}` applies to that engine only and wins. Unmapped locales fall back to the engine's alias table; if nothing matches, translation reports an explicit error instead of silently skipping.

**Prefer the command over hand-written JSON**: [Open the visual locale mapping](command:i18n-ally.config-translate-locales) scans the project's locale files, lists the languages the engine supports, and writes the result into **this project's** `.vscode/settings.json`. [Open this project's settings.json](command:i18n-ally.open-workspace-settings) shows that file. The settings editor's built-in “Edit in settings.json” opens the **user-level** file, which leaks one project's mapping into another.

If no locale file is found, first check that `#i18n-ally.localesPaths#` points at a directory that exists, then whether `#i18n-ally.pathMatcher#` can extract `{locale}` from the JSON file names. “Diagnose current configuration” in the visual editor lists the exact reasons and offers a one-click fix.
config.locales_paths: Folders that hold locale files, relative to the workspace root, e.g. ["src/locales", "src/i18n"]. Glob patterns work too. When the extension reports “no locale file found”, this is the first thing to check.
config.namespace: Turn on namespaces — keys are then written as "namespace:key" and each namespace lives in its own file.
config.openai_api_key: API key for OpenAI, or for any gateway that speaks the OpenAI protocol.
config.openai_api_model: Which model to call — decides translation quality, speed and cost.
config.openai_api_model.gpt-3.5-turbo: GPT-3.5, 4K context — cheapest and fastest, multi-language quality is average.
config.openai_api_model.gpt-3.5-turbo-03: Fixed 2023-03-01 snapshot of GPT-3.5 — stable behaviour for reproducible runs.
config.openai_api_model.gpt-3.5-turbo-16: GPT-3.5 with a 16K context — fits much longer texts into one request.
config.openai_api_model.gpt-4: GPT-4 — best quality, slower and more expensive.
config.openai_api_model.gpt-4-32k: GPT-4 with a 32K context — very long documents in one request.
config.openai_api_root: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Set it when going through a proxy or a self-hosted gateway.
config.parser_options: Raw options passed to each parser (e.g. YAML load/dump options)
config.parsers_extend_file_extensions: Extra file extensions to enable for each parser, e.g. {"json": ["jsonc"]}
config.path_matcher: Pattern that extracts the locale (and namespace) from a file path, e.g. "{locale}.{ext}" or "locales/{locale}/{namespace}.json". Available placeholders: {locale}, {namespace}, {ext}, {fileName}. Only needed when the default cannot parse your file names.
config.preferred_delimiter: Preferred delimiter of composed keypath, default to "-"(dash)
config.prompt_translating_source: Prompt to select source locale on translating every time. If set false, the source language in the config will be used.
config.readonly: Disable every write to locale files — extraction, translation, editing and quick fixes only preview, nothing is saved.
config.refactor_templates: Array of template strings. Use `{key}` for placeholder of keypaths.
config.regex_key: RegEx used to recognise keys in code. Overrides the pattern provided by the framework.
config.regex_usage_match: Array of RegEx strings to match key usages in code. It will override Regex provided by frameworks.
config.regex_usage_match_append: Array of RegEx strings to match key usages in code. Unlike "regex.usageMatch", it will append to the Regex list instead of replacing it.
config.review_email: Your email, recorded with reviews and used as the Gravatar for your avatar.
config.review_enabled: Enable the review workflow — translations, their author and status (pending / approved / rejected) are recorded in .vscode/i18n-ally-reviews.yml.
config.review_gutters: Show a coloured marker in the editor gutter for entries with a pending or rejected review.
config.review_remove_on_resolved: Remove the comment instead of marking it as resolved.
config.review_username: Your name, recorded as the author of the translations you review.
config.ruby_scope_root: Root directory of Ruby on Rails views, used to resolve view paths
config.show_flags: Show a country flag next to each locale code in the sidebar and menus.
config.sort_compare: Strategy for sorting keys when writing locale files
config.sort_compare.binary: Compare by raw character code — stable and language independent
config.sort_compare.locale: Compare by the collation rules of a language (set it with i18n-ally.sortLocale)
config.sort_keys: Sort keys whenever a locale file is written (order defined by sortCompare / sortLocale).
config.sort_locale: Locale whose collation rules are used when sortCompare = locale, e.g. "zh-CN". Empty means: use the file's own locale.
config.source_language: Locale id that holds the source text — the code inside the locale file name (zh-CN, chs, en). If the project has no such file, the real file is matched by language (zh-CN ↔ chs).
config.sync_backend_base_url: i18n backend base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8862.
config.sync_backend_enabled: After extracting, push every $t() key used in the file to the i18n backend (same as the admin page add-frontend action).
config.sync_backend_sync_endpoint: Dev-server endpoint that runs the locale sync script. Empty skips the local locale refresh.
config.sync_backend_token: Auth token (value of the ems_Token cookie). Leave empty to log in with the local credentials instead.
config.sync_backend_token_header: Header name carrying the auth token (value of the ems_TokenName cookie).
config.sync_backend_translate_after_sync: Run Translate All Missing after refreshing locales.
config.sync_backend_type: Business type used when linking the key (POST /i18n/type).
config.target_picking_strategy: Strategy dealing with more than one locale files were found.
config.target_picking_strategy.file-prev: Reuse the locale file you chose last time for this same source file.
config.target_picking_strategy.global-pr: Reuse the locale file chosen in the previous extraction, whatever the source file was.
config.target_picking_strategy.most-simi: Pick by path similarity — write into the locale file whose path is closest to the current source file.
Pick by key similarity — write into the locale file that best matches the key. Handy in multi-namespace projects.
config.target_picking_strategy.none: Ask each time which locale file to write into.
config.theme_annotation: Color of the inline annotation text
config.theme_annotation_border: Border color of the inline annotation
config.theme_annotation_missing: Color of the inline annotation text when the translation is missing
config.theme_annotation_missing_border: Border color of the inline annotation when the translation is missing
config.translate.engines: Translation engines to use, tried in the order listed. Credentials differ per engine: deepl / baidu / openai need a key, libretranslate needs a server URL, google works without one.
config.translate.engines.baidu: Baidu Translate — needs APPID + secret, good for Chinese source text.
config.translate.engines.deepl: DeepL — high quality, needs an API key, generous free tier.
config.translate.engines.google: Google Translate via googleapis — no key needed, decent speed.
config.translate.engines.google-cn: Google Translate through the mainland mirror (google.cn) — use it when googleapis is unreachable.
config.translate.engines.libretranslate: LibreTranslate — free and self-hostable, point it at your own server.
config.translate.engines.openai: OpenAI (GPT models) — keeps terminology and context best, slowest and most expensive.
config.translate.fallbackToKey: Use key itself to translate when there is no source translation for that key.
config.translate.parallels: How many translation requests may run at the same time. Lower it when an engine rate-limits or returns errors.
config.translate_on_extract: Automatically translate newly extracted keys into other locales using the configured translate engines
config.translate_override_existing: Also translate keys that already have a value in the target locale, overwriting it. Off by default — only missing entries are translated.
config.translate_save_as_candidates: Save translations result to "Translation Candidates" instead of writting to the locale files.
config.ts_compiler_options: Compiler options used when parsing TypeScript files — same fields as compilerOptions in tsconfig.json, e.g. { "target": "es2017", "jsx": "preserve" }.
config.ts_node_path: Path to the ts-node binary, used to parse TypeScript files
config.usage.scanning_ignore: Glob patterns of files to skip when scanning where keys are used, e.g. "dist/**". Keeps generated code from counting as usage.
